result.title: Training-free Conditional Object Composition for Multi-object Image Generation with Diffusion Models
result.comment: Accepted for oral presentation at TAAI 2026
result.summary: Multi-object image generation in text-to-image diffusion models remains challenging, as existing approaches struggle to reliably generate all objects specified in a prompt. Compositional approaches that generate objects independently often fail to capture the interactions among them, whereas joint generation methods tend to suffer from inter-object interference. In this work, we propose a training-free framework, termed conditional object composition, that relaxes joint generation methods by taking one step back toward compositional approaches. Our framework decomposes the generation of $N$ objects into two stages: it first generates a subset of $N-1$ objects and then composes the remaining object conditioned on the generated content. To enable effective composition, we adopt an inpainting-based formulation with layout guidance to preserve existing regions and encourage spatially coherent placement. To address the challenge of selecting which objects to generate separately, we introduce an attention-based scoring mechanism based on cross-attention maps and further explore the use of off-the-shelf object detectors. We evaluate our method on multi-object image generation using the widely adopted MS COCO dataset. Experimental results show that our approach achieves competitive or improved performance compared to existing methods, particularly as the number of objects increases. Further studies highlight the importance of the proposed design choices. The source code is available at https://github.com/ShampooWang/condComp_imageGen/tree/main

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的条件物体组合框架，将 N 个物体的生成拆成先生成 N−1 个物体、再在已生成内容条件下组合剩余物体，并用 inpainting 式布局引导与基于 cross-attention 的物体选择评分。
AI.relevance_reason: 属文本到图像扩散模型的生成质量与布局控制工作，既无内部推理状态或视觉证据筛选，也不涉及 VLM 推理过程，cross-attention 评分仅用于选择生成哪个物体，缺乏可迁移至 LVR 状态使用与决策的具体线索。
